title: Vision: "What Don't I Know About User's Preferences?" How Uncertainty Estimation Improves Proactive Assistant Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.15948v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Proactive Smart Assistants (PSAs) increasingly use general knowledge, learned patterns from group-level data, patterns from individual user's data, and recent sensor observations to anticipate which action a user may prefer. Existing systems typically select actions from predicted user preference likelihoods, but these likelihoods alone do not reveal how reliable the prediction is, which evidence supports it, or why ambiguity remains. In this vision paper, we argue that uncertainty estimation can provide this missing information and substantially change appropriate downstream behavior. translated_title: 愿景：“我对用户的偏好有哪些不了解？”——不确定性估计如何改进主动式助手的对齐
translated_abstract: 主动式智能助手日益依赖通用知识、从群体级数据中学习到的模式、从个体用户数据中学习到的模式，以及最近的传感器观测，来预测用户可能偏好的行动。现有系统通常基于预测出的用户偏好可能性来选择行动，但这些可能性本身无法揭示预测的可靠程度、有哪些证据支持该预测，以及为何仍然存在模糊性。在这篇愿景论文中，我们认为不确定性估计可以提供这些缺失的信息，并实质性改变适合的下游行为。以家庭助手为例，我们提出了不确定性估计旨在回答的问题，即：助手对其预测的偏好可能性有多确定？这种信心是来自群体层面的假设还是来自个体数据？可能性的模糊性究竟反映了用户内在的偏好变异性，还是证据不足。
tldr: 这篇愿景论文提出，通过不确定性估计来量化主动式智能助手对用户偏好预测的可靠性、证据来源与模糊性成因，从而改变助手的下游行为并改进其与用户的主动对齐。
en_tdlr: This vision paper argues that uncertainty estimation can reveal how reliable a proactive assistant's preference predictions are, where the confidence comes from, and why ambiguity remains, thereby reshaping downstream behavior and improving proactive assistant-user alignment.
